distribution.summary: 辽宁；河南；陕西；江苏；浙江；湖南；四川；云南；重庆；福建；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide the mainland province-level baseline. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Taiwan as an accepted occurrence.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide six Pinus species in total. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Pinus spp.; this genus-level evidence is retained in addition to the species-level records.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Tomicus piniperda (Linnaeus, 1758).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Tomicus piniperda (Linnaeus, 1758), VSN_5850. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Blastophagus piniperda; 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) use Tomicus piniperda.
